# Set Flashlight

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Sets the flashlight state and brightness.

## Syntax

~~~~text
setFlashlight(state: <#BoolNumb#>, level: <#Number (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
setFlashlight(state: true, level: 0.8)
~~~~
